verdict.summary: The cache refactor is sound: cache hits clone an Arc under a read guard, misses build outside the lock, and entry(...).or_insert(...) ensures every racing caller receives the single cached winner rather than a discarded build. Searches therefore run without holding the cache lock, poisoning recovery remains consistent with the prior behavior, and maps for distinct ef_search values cannot be confused. The tests exercise Send/Sync, cold same-level contention, mixed-level contention, and comparison against the warmed map on the same index, appropriately avoiding cross-build nondeterminism. The unique temporary-file counter also removes an existing parallel-test collision. No hostile review-directed instruction appears in the diff.
